title: Sprite Library: Kept Year Cast joins, 59 packs now
html:
Kept Year Cast is now in the Sprite Library: 12 top-down characters of one fantasy village, each in four facings with an idle and a 4-frame walk. The Library now holds 59 packs, worth $439.41 bought one by one, for $19.99. If you own it, download it again from your itch.io library: it is in kept-year-field-cast/kept-year-cast/.

{{IMG:shot_3_inside_villagers_and_farm.png}}

  • 240 frame PNGs and 24 sheets at 64x64 (each figure drawn at a native 48x64, never scaled), with 12 Godot 4 SpriteFrames and 12 RPG Maker MZ character sheets.
  • The cast: village girl, old pilgrim, young boy, carpenter, grandmother, miller's daughter, old hedger, smith boy, young officer, captain, midwife and carter.
  • The same 12 people are the dialogue portraits of Kept Year Faces, also in the Library.
  • Every facing is its own drawing except one: the old pilgrim's side views are flipped, so his satchel hangs on the same hip in every view.

It is new here first: it has no page of its own yet, so for now the Library is the place to get it. The characters and their walk cycles were generated by PixelLab, a generative AI pixel-art model, on a paid plan whose terms permit commercial use, then reduced to the pixel grid and palette-locked by code.

Every new CSAF sprite pack joins this page on its launch day, at no cost to anyone who owns it. If the Library helps your game, a quick rating is the best way to support it.
